concerns.text: The plan claims that 10 Monte‑Carlo runs per configuration provide ≥ 80 % power to detect an effect size ≥ 0.1 at α = 0.05 (see FR‑003). With only 10 samples per group the statistical power of a two‑sample permutation test (or any t‑like test) is far lower than 80 % for such a small effect; this claim is unsupported and makes the planned significance testing under‑powered.
